title: Autosomal dominant family
goal: A reader can trace an affected lineage through four generations and identify the proband and unaffected relatives.

rubric.must: The drawing has four generation rows labeled I, II, III, and IV, with all individual symbol centers in each row on the same horizontal level.
Every individual has a legible generation-number label below the symbol, with numbering starting at 1 and increasing consecutively from left to right within each generation.
An affected individual appears in each of the four generations, and every affected individual below generation I has a visible parent-child connection to at least one affected parent.
Affected individuals have fully dark symbols, unaffected individuals have empty symbols, and an affected father is visibly connected to an affected son.
Exactly one family member has a proband arrow labeled P, and its tip clearly points to the affected female IV-1 without touching another individual.
Every child is connected to the correct pair of parents by an unbroken descent line from their union, without any line crossing an unrelated individual symbol.

ideal.notes: Four generation rows I-IV with a solid-filled affected individual in every generation, father-to-son transmission down the left edge, and a P arrow on affected female IV-1.
